sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
data=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
print("size",len(data))
print("magic anywhere:", data.find(b'SQLite format 3'))
print("testword count:", data.count(b'testword'))
import re
print([m.start() for m in re.finditer(b'testword..', data)])

def varint(buf,pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8:
            v=(v<<8)|b
            return v,pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not (b&0x80):
            return v,pos+i+1
    raise ValueError

def serial_len(t):
    if t==0: return 0,t
    if t in (1,): return 1,'int'
    if t==2: return 2,'int'
    if t==3: return 3,'int'
    if t==4: return 4,'int'
    if t==5: return 6,'int'
    if t==6: return 8,'int'
    if t==7: return 8,'float'
    if t==8: return 0,'const0'
    if t==9: return 0,'const1'
    if t in (10,11): return 0,'reserved'
    if t%2==0: return (t-12)//2,'blob'
    return (t-13)//2,'text'

ptype=data[0]
ncell=int.from_bytes(data[3:5],'big')
cstart=int.from_bytes(data[5:7],'big')
print("page type",hex(ptype),"ncells",ncell,"cell content start",hex(cstart))
ptrs=[int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]
print("ptrs",[hex(p) for p in ptrs])

def parse_cell(p):
    plen,q=varint(data,p)
    rowid,q=varint(data,q)
    payload_start=q
    payload=data[q:q+plen]
    if len(payload)<plen:
        print("  SHORT payload at",hex(p),"want",plen,"got",len(payload))
    hlen,hp=varint(payload,0)
    serials=[]
    while hp<hlen:
        t,hp=varint(payload,hp)
        serials.append(t)
    body=payload[hlen:]
    vals=[]
    bp=0
    for t in serials:
        ln,kind=serial_len(t)
        raw=body[bp:bp+ln]; bp+=ln
        if kind=='int':
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(raw,'big',signed=True))
        elif kind=='const0': vals.append(0)
        elif kind=='const1': vals.append(1)
        elif kind=='text': vals.append(raw.decode('utf-8','replace'))
        elif kind=='blob': vals.append(raw)
        elif kind=='float':
            import struct; vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',raw)[0])
        else: vals.append((kind,raw))
    return rowid,serials,vals,q+plen,plen

rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    rowid,serials,vals,end,plen=parse_cell(p)
    print(hex(p),"rowid",rowid,"plen",plen,"serials",serials,"vals",vals,"end",hex(end))
    rows.append(vals)
print("---free/other nonzero regions---")
# find nonzero gaps outside known used area
used=set()
for p in ptrs:
    r,s,v,e,pl=parse_cell(p)
    used.update(range(p,e))
for i in range(len(data)):
    if data[i]!=0 and i not in used and i>=8+2*ncell:
        print("extra nonzero at",hex(i),hex(data[i]))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, struct

data=open('trunc.db','rb').read()

def varint(buf,pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8:
            return (v<<8)|b, pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not (b&0x80):
            return v, pos+i+1
    raise ValueError

def slen(t):
    if t==0: return 0,'null'
    if t==1: return 1,'int'
    if t==2: return 2,'int'
    if t==3: return 3,'int'
    if t==4: return 4,'int'
    if t==5: return 6,'int'
    if t==6: return 8,'int'
    if t==7: return 8,'float'
    if t==8: return 0,'const0'
    if t==9: return 0,'const1'
    if t in (10,11): return 0,'reserved'
    if t%2==0: return (t-12)//2,'blob'
    return (t-13)//2,'text'

assert data[0]==0x0d, "expected table leaf page"
ncell=int.from_bytes(data[3:5],'big')
cells=[int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]

def parse(p):
    plen,q=varint(data,p)
    rowid,q=varint(data,q)
    payload=data[q:q+plen]
    hlen,hp=varint(payload,0)
    types=[]
    while hp<hlen:
        t,hp=varint(payload,hp); types.append(t)
    body=payload[hlen:]; bp=0; vals=[]
    for t in types:
        ln,kind=slen(t); raw=body[bp:bp+ln]; bp+=ln
        if kind=='int': vals.append(int.from_bytes(raw,'big',signed=True))
        elif kind=='const0': vals.append(0)
        elif kind=='const1': vals.append(1)
        elif kind=='text': vals.append(raw.decode('utf-8'))
        elif kind=='blob': vals.append(raw.hex())
        elif kind=='float': vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',raw)[0])
        else: vals.append(None)
    return rowid,vals

records=sorted((parse(p) for p in cells), key=lambda x:x[0])
rows=[{"word":v[1],"value":v[2]} for _,v in records]
with open('/workspace/recover.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(rows,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')

print(open('/workspace/recover.json').read())
chk=json.load(open('/workspace/recover.json'))
assert chk==rows and len(rows)==10
print("OK: valid JSON,",len(rows),"rows")
PY
echo "--- file location ---"
ls -l /app/recover.json
EOF
